mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 4% indicates accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k/month, the labor market's dual indicators signal economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with triggered labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window with triggered INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS below 700k signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS below 700k.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% and CPIAUCSL growth slows below 2% YoY, the monetary policy's dual indicators signal a controlled inflation environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances with triggered monetary conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: the labor market's overall health, as proxied by UNRATE, predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with lower UNRATE indicating economic strength.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST above 1500k signals increased housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of mid-cycle quarters with triggered HOUST growth.
